title: The activities of the CCP’s 21-machine warship around the Taiwan Strait are closely monitored by the national military and should be dealt with
title_original: 中共21機艦船台海周邊活動 國軍嚴密監控應處
summary: （中央社記者吳書緯台北14日電）國防部表示，自昨天上午6時至今天上午6時，偵獲共機10架次，其中4架次逾越中線進入中部、西南及東部空域，以及8艘共艦及3艘公務船，總計中共21機艦船持續在台海周邊活動，國軍嚴密監控與應處。

summary: Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) The Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) on Thursday urged Beijing to recognize the continued existence of the Republic of China (ROC) and respect Taiwan's democracy after Chinese President Xi Jinping (習近平) reiterated that unification with Taiwan was inevitable.

title: Taiwan lawmakers clash over nuclear power referendum
summary: Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) Ruling and opposition lawmakers clashed during a televised presentation Thursday over a Nov. 28 referendum on nuclear power, disagreeing over its economic benefits, electricity costs, energy security and nuclear safety.
